purpose: compact payload the public site rebuilds into the exact float32 submission raster; pixels are verified by SHA-256 over the raw little-endian float32 array
format: G7PL1: zlib(deflate, level 9) of an H*W uint8 code array, base64-encoded
reconstruction_rule: codes -> float32 with 0.0/1.0/NaN, then written as a single-strip, deflate-compressed, single-band float32 GeoTIFF whose georeferencing tags are copied byte-for-byte from the template raster
